jobs.title: Senior Structural Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview:** Our client, an engineering firm specializing in renewable energy, water, and environmental solutions, is seeking a **Senior Structural Engineer** to manage projects, lead multidisciplinary teams, and support the design of hydroelectric, fisheries, and water resource infrastructure. This role combines technical design and project leadership responsibilities, including structural analysis of concrete and steel systems, coordination across engineering disciplines, and direct client interaction throughout project execution. The Senior Structural Engineer will oversee multiple projects, ensure quality and consistency in deliverables, and contribute to team development and long\-term client relationships. **This is a full\-time position open to candidates located in Portland, OR; Redmond, WA; Essex, CT; Falmouth, ME; and Pittsfield, ME.** **Pay range: $112,000 \- $170,000 DOE** **Benefits:*** Comprehensive medical/dental/vision package * 401(k) with 4% employer match and 100% immediate vesting * 10 Floating Holidays * Company Paid Short\-Term Disability and Life Insurance * Paid Parental Leave * Tuition Assistance * Employee Ownership **Responsibilities:*** Technical Expertise and Design Leadership: * Perform advanced structural engineering analysis and design, applying standard and advanced engineering principles across complex projects. * Develop and implement improved techniques, procedures, and design solutions that enhance technical capabilities. * Review analyses and designs to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement. * Apply interdisciplinary engineering knowledge, including regulatory and permitting considerations. * Serve as a technical lead on multi\-discipline projects and may act as a Discipline Group Leader. * Project Management and Execution: * Manage or support multiple projects, overseeing scope, schedule, and quality of deliverables. * Coordinate detailed phases of engineering work and ensure alignment across project teams. * Estimate resource needs, assign tasks, and monitor progress to meet deadlines. * Provide leadership on project scope, objectives, budgets, and execution strategies. * Client and Team Collaboration: * Lead client meetings and serve as a representative of the firm. * Build and maintain strong client relationships to support ongoing and future work. * Collaborate with internal teams across disciplines to deliver integrated project solutions. * Mentor and guide junior staff, including reviewing work for QA/QC and supporting development. * Business Development and Ownership: * Support proposal development and contribute to competitive positioning of the firm. * Maintain and grow relationships with existing and prospective clients. * Contribute to internal and external technical knowledge sharing through training, presentations, or publications. **Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program or related field. * Licensed Professional Engineer (PE). * 10\+ years of experience in structural engineering. * Experience with hydroelectric, fisheries, or water resource projects preferred. * Specialized experience within structural engineering such as seismic design or finite element modeling is a plus. * Strong knowledge of engineering principles, standards, and codes applicable to structural engineering (e.g., AISC, IEEE, ASME). * Experience with analysis and design of concrete and steel structures, particularly in and around water environments. * Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams including hydrology/hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, and geotechnical engineers. * Proficiency with structural modeling and design software such as MathCAD, RISA\-3D, SAP2000, AutoCAD, and Revit. * Proficiency with CAD software and discipline\-specific engineering tools. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to manage projects and client relationships. * Experience working with clients and contractors during planning and construction phases. * Familiarity with regulatory and permitting processes is a plus. * Proven experience managing project teams, including junior and senior staff, drafters, and coordinators. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines. * Experience serving as a Project Manager and/or Technical Lead on multidisciplinary projects. * Experience preparing proposals and supporting business development efforts. * Ability to build and maintain long\-term client relationships and contribute to ongoing business development. * Passion for mentoring and developing junior staff, including reviewing work for quality and consistency. * Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams across all phases of a project lifecycle. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, and Outlook. * Ability to develop and expand technical specialties within the discipline and contribute to knowledge sharing. * Must possess permanent authorization to work in the United States and be able to acquire authorization to work in Canada. * Must be willing to travel and possess a valid driver’s license. Work sponsorship is not available at this time. Third\-party candidates will not be considered for this position. jobs.title: Field CTO - Data & Agentic Transformation, Google Cloud
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We're the Accenture Google Business Group Mid\-Market team, a specialized group of engineers, architects, and builders delivering tailored Google Cloud solutions for mid\-market, high\-growth, and fast\-paced enterprises. We partner with dynamic organizations to connect them with the right combination of Accenture solutions and Google Cloud products to accelerate business transformation and solve real\-world problems, quickly. We're expanding our team to meet the unique, rapid execution needs of the mid\-market segment. **The Domain** Data and AI are no longer back\-office functions — they're the engine of every modern business decision. And with the arrival of agentic AI, we're entering a new era: intelligent agents that don't just analyze data but act on it — automating complex workflows, making autonomous decisions, and transforming how companies operate. Google Cloud is leading this shift with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI, and the most powerful data stack in the industry. Our mid\-market clients need lean, agile leaders who can unlock massive amounts of untapped data and rapidly turn it into a distinct competitive advantage. **The Role** You're the person the client trusts to make it happen. As a Technical Delivery Lead, you own delivery from initial solution shaping through go\-live. You design the execution approach for data and AI engagements, lead the implementation, and ensure the final product fundamentally upgrades how the client leverages data and intelligent automation. You're supported by a dedicated offshore engineering team — you set the strategic direction, and they build alongside you. But you're the single point of accountability for what ships. This role is for an execution\-focused leader who takes full ownership of their work. You care deeply about delivery quality, data architecture outcomes, agent design, and speed\-to\-value for the business. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would. You'll work directly with client stakeholders — immersing yourself in their environment, understanding their fast\-evolving resource constraints, and delivering outcomes that matter in weeks, not quarters. You'll have the autonomy to shape how they experience the full power of Google Cloud's data and AI stack, from first conversation to go\-live. **What You'll Do** * **Own the delivery.** End\-to\-end. Scope, timeline, team structure, quality, outcome. You're the single point of accountability the client relies on. * **Design how it gets delivered.** Shape the delivery approach for complex data and AI engagements — define the delivery plan, phase the work, structure the team, and manage dependencies across data engineering, analytics, and AI workstreams. Partner with solution engineers who own the technical architecture; you own how it gets executed and shipped. * **Provide technical advisory across the engagement** — Guide our mid\-market clients and teams on our offerings, technical implementation, and the underlying Google Cloud services, with a deep understanding of each client's existing environment and architecture. * **Be the client's trusted delivery partner.** You're the face of the engagement. Lead status reviews, manage expectations, navigate trade\-offs in real time, and ensure the client always knows where things stand — especially when the work involves iterative AI development where scope evolves. * **Get solutions into clients' hands fast.** Pick up where the deal ends and make it real. Stand up the delivery, mobilize the team, and drive execution from day one — delivering proven capabilities in weeks, not quarters. * **Lead across borders.** Coordinate onshore delivery leadership with offshore engineering teams. Set priorities, define workstreams, remove blockers, and keep the entire delivery machine moving at pace. * **Drive quality and outcomes.** Establish delivery governance, define checkpoints, track progress against commitments, and ensure every engagement delivers measurable client value — from data platform readiness to AI models in production. **Technical Skills \& Domain Expertise** * Data Platforms \& Engineering: Advanced proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Spanner, and Bigtable for data migration, modernization, pipeline design, data quality governance, and lakehouse architecture patterns. * Analytics \& Business Intelligence: Hands\-on experience executing Looker deployments, connected sheets integrations, real\-time operational dashboards, and semantic modeling. * Artificial Intelligence \& Machine Learning: Core understanding of Vertex AI, Gemini models, AutoML, custom model training, and building production\-grade MLOps deployment pipelines. * Agentic \& Generative AI Patterns: Working knowledge of modern agent orchestration patterns, including tool use, grounding mechanisms, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Development Kit (ADK), A2A protocol, and Mod al, vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. Formed in 2025 as part of Accenture’s expanded strategic partnership with Palantir, APBG serves as a center of excellence delivering Palantir‑enabled solutions across industries such as government, healthcare, energy, financial services, and manufacturing. The group accelerates enterprise reinvention by integrating consulting, engineering, and global delivery capabilities to move clients from siloed data to integrated, AI‑driven decision intelligence. **You Are:** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be responsible for helping our clients solve their most pressing challenges, from the battlefield to supply chains, benefits programs, and broader government operations. jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer
jobs.description: Our client is an AI consulting and implementation company working exclusively within the Direct Selling industry. They help businesses move from AI curiosity to real AI capability by working closely with leadership teams. Their focus is on implementing practical AI solutions while building the tools, governance, and internal confidence clients need to continue progressing independently. They are looking for an **AI Agents \& Automations Engineer** with strong engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-ready AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different AI agent and automation frameworks and understands the importance of reliability, integrations, monitoring, error handling, and maintainability. The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Build the infrastructure around agents, including triggers, queues, error handling, retries, fallbacks and monitoring; * Define the access and infrastructure requirements for each solution, including credentials, permissions, data access, rate limits, service accounts and audit trails; * Design appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop processes where full automation is not suitable. **Agentic AI \& automation:** * Build solutions using different agent and automation frameworks such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Select the right framework and architecture based on the business problem rather than defaulting to a single technology; * Integrate AI agents with external APIs, business systems and data sources; * Turn successful one\-off client implementations into reusable patterns and components. **Client discovery \& solution design:** * Work directly with Operations, Sales, Support, Finance and other client teams to understand existing workflows and identify automation opportunities; * Determine which processes are worth automating and where AI agents can deliver measurable business value; * Translate non\-technical business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications; * Explain technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& continuous improvement:** * Document solutions and conduct handover sessions so client and internal teams can independently maintain what has been built; * Help establish reusable engineering standards and processes for AI agent and automation development; * Automate internal workflows and identify opportunities to improve how the company itself uses AI. ‍ #### **Requirements** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python or TypeScript; * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents / agentic workflows in production, not only prototypes or sandbox projects; * Hands\-on experience with several agent or automation technologies such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Confident working with APIs, integrations and webhooks; * Comfortable with production engineering topics including authentication, scopes, secrets management, logging, monitoring, cost control and API limitations; * Enough infrastructure knowledge to independently deploy and maintain the solutions you build; * Able to demonstrate 2–3 AI agents you have built and deployed with measurable business outcomes such as hours saved, reduced error rates, improved cycle times or revenue impact; * Strong client\-facing and discovery skills with the ability to communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders and turn business problems into technical solutions; * Advanced English level; * Pragmatic engineering mindset: able to choose a simple, reliable solution over unnecessary technical complexity. ### **Bonus points for** * Experience with AI evals, observability or agent monitoring; * Experience with RAG and vector databases; * Frontend development experience sufficient to build usable interfaces around AI solutions; * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration; * Security, data protection or compliance experience; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; * A permanent, fully remote role with a basic salary and the potential to participate in the share option scheme; * A seat at the table on how we evolve our methodology, our tooling and the way we work with clients. We want you shaping the playbook, not just following it.

You will work on services that connect web and mobile applications with CRM and other enterprise systems. The role requires strong Python engineering skills, hands\-on Azure experience and a solid understanding of distributed systems, API architecture, security and integration patterns. **What You’ll Do** * Design and develop production\-grade backend applications using Python and FastAPI. * Create reusable REST APIs and backend services for web and mobile applications. * Build Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF) services where experience\-specific APIs are required. * Integrate backend applications with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse and other enterprise platforms. * Develop integration and abstraction layers that isolate applications from underlying third\-party platform implementations. * Design services that aggregate information and actions across multiple enterprise systems. * Implement synchronous APIs, asynchronous processing and event\-driven workflows. * Build secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OIDC and JWT\-based approaches. * Implement resilient distributed\-system patterns including retries, timeouts, idempotency, rate limiting and circuit breaking. * Develop caching and optimized data\-access strategies for high\-volume application workloads. * Use Azure services for API management, application hosting, messaging, secrets management and monitoring. * Implement structured logging, telemetry and distributed tracing. * Develop automated unit, integration and API contract tests. * Participate in CI/CD pipelines, code reviews and engineering quality controls. * Diagnose and resolve complex application and integration issues in production environments. * Collaborate with frontend, mobile, platform, CRM and architecture teams. **Core Skills** * Advanced Python development * FastAPI or comparable Python API frameworks * RESTful API design * Microservices and distributed systems * Backend\-for\-Frontend architecture * Microsoft Azure development * Azure API Management * Azure Service Bus and/or Event Grid * Azure Functions, App Service and/or container\-based deployments * SQL and NoSQL databases * Redis or comparable distributed caching technologies * OAuth 2\.0, OIDC and JWT * Event\-driven application architecture * Observability and distributed tracing * Automated testing * CI/CD pipelines * Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Dataverse API integration **Preferred Background** Additional value would come from experience with: * Enterprise CRM integrations * API gateways and enterprise integration platforms * High\-volume application and API environments * Event\-driven processing and data projection patterns * Integrating CRM platforms with document, analytics, data or workflow systems * Secure or regulated enterprise environments * Cloud\-native application development Pay: $106,342\.23 \- $128,068\.06 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Jose, CA 95139

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Digital Consumer
jobs.description: As a Senior Full Stack Engineer within our digital engineering team, you help design and deliver customer facing digital applications at scale, building the experiences that bring Chubb Personal Risk Services’ promise to life for the agents who champion our clients, the clients who trust us, and the internal teams who deliver on that trust every day. With us, you will be a hands on contributor and key owner of partner integrations and new insurance product capabilities, developing robust solutions across the full stack, web, mobile, and APIs. You bring strong engineering discipline, a security first mindset, and a genuine obsession for customer experience in a globally connected environment where the best digital experiences are fast, intuitive, secure, and reliable. That is the standard we are setting for PRS, and you will play a key role in helping us deliver it. If you have spent your career focused on what makes digital products feel effortless and understand what it takes to make a premier brand feel premier in every interaction, we’d love to talk. **In this role, you will:** * Design, develop, and own Full Stack features and services using .NET (backend) and Angular (frontend), with a focus on performance, availability, and security * Lead delivery of partner integrations and new insurance product capabilities within the Digital Group * Build and ship customer\-facing applications that prioritize usability, reliability, and end\-to\-end experience quality * Leverage AI\-assisted development tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI\-driven code review and test generation) to accelerate SDLC velocity and code quality * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions * Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior and mid\-level engineers on the team * Architect and deploy cloud\-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, applying best practices for scalability, security, and global availability * Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to software development standards * 8–10 years of Full Stack engineering experience * Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline * Demonstrated strength in both .NET and Angular preferred * Proven track record delivering customer facing digital products in insurance, retail, hospitality, or consumer goods * Solid grasp of software engineering principles including design patterns, API design, testing strategies, and secure coding practices * Experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud native development patterns * Familiarity with AI assisted development tools that accelerate the software delivery lifecycle * Demonstrated ability to lead or mentor a small engineering team in a fast paced, agile environment Ability to collaborate across global time zones * The pay range for the role is $160,000 to $180,000\. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website . The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled. Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance, and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is distinguished by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength, underwriting excellence, superior claims handling expertise and local operations globally. At Chubb, we are committed to equal employment opportunity and compliance with all laws and regulations pertaining to it. jobs.title: Engineering Product Manager - Mobility
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 09/27/2026This position can sit remotely anywhere in the continental US and be willing to travel up to 30%. Meet the Team We are a small, agile, and highly collaborative unit focused on delivering strategic mobility, IoT, and SaaS solutions for some of the largest service providers. We move with precision and vitality, relying on strong cross\-functional partnerships across product, engineering, sales, customer success, legal, finance, and operations to achieve business outcomes. We operate with a strong ownership attitude — “you build it, you run it” — where product leaders are encouraged to actively participate in crafting strategy, supporting execution, solving customer challenges, and driving continuous improvement across the product lifecycle. Your Impact Serve as the primary Product Lifecycle Manager (PLM) for a Tier\-1 U.S. Service Provider, driving the strategic roadmap through 5G\-to\-6G transitions. You will oversee product lifecycles, scale IoT and Edge AI initiatives, and engage executive collaborators to align Cisco’s cross\-functional capabilities with the customer’s long\-term business goals. Business Growth and Portfolio Integration * Identify and assemble growth opportunities beyond the core contract by developing value propositions in Edge AI, AI inferencing, and mobility infrastructure. * Align IoT Control Center business teams, mobility units, and broader Cisco product organizations to deliver a unified service provider value proposition. * Build data\-backed business cases that connect Cisco technology to measurable customer outcomes. Executive Communication and Stakeholder Management * Engage with senior customer executives and internal leadership to shape strategic positioning and communicate roadmaps. * Navigate large, matrixed organizations to influence cross\-functional teams and align collaborators toward shared achievements. * Operate with high autonomy to handle risks and navigate ambiguous environments optimally. Minimum Qualifications * 10\+ years of experience in product management, product lifecycle management, solution architecture, service provider networking, mobility, IoT, or related technology domains. * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline. * Experience with mobility technologies and standards, such as; 3GPP, LTE/4G, 5G, 5G\-Advanced, and evolving 6G concepts. * Experience working with service provider networks, mobility solutions, or large\-scale telecom infrastructure. * Experience supporting strategic customers and translating customer needs into product requirements and business outcomes. * Executive level communication skills such as; presenting to senior leadership, customer executives and cross\-functional collaborators. * Navigate matrixed organizations to influence teams without direct authority Preferred Qualifications * Experience working with Tier\-1 U.S. service providers. * Knowledge of Cisco mobility solutions, IoT Control Center, CMP platforms, or service provider SaaS offers. * Understanding of emerging technology areas such as AI RAN, Edge AI, AI infrastructure, AI inferencing, and network modernization. * Experience building business cases, customer growth strategies, roadmap proposals, or commercial expansion plans. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.title: IT Architect - Integrations
jobs.description: ### **It's fun to work in a company where people truly** **BELIEVE** **in what they're doing!** *We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.* The IT Architect designs, plans, and governs technical solutions that enable secure, reliable, and efficient City operations across enterprise applications, data/analytics, infrastructure, networking, cloud platforms, information security, and end\-user technologies. The role partners with IT teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable architecture, standards, roadmaps, and reusable patterns; leads or advises delivery teams during implementation; and documents solutions to ensure maintainability, compliance, and long\-term value. Work is performed under general direction with latitude for initiative and independent judgment.**Applicants are required to attach a resume and cover letter.** **Integration Architect Focus:** This position will serve as a hands\-on technical architect for the City’s enterprise integration environment, with Microsoft Azure Logic Apps as a primary integration platform. The role will design and build integrations between major enterprise, financial, HR, utility, public safety, asset management, and customer service systems. The position will work closely with City departments, application teams, subject\-matter experts, and technology vendors to understand business processes and translate them into reliable, maintainable integrations. The City’s integration environment includes Workday and other SaaS, vendor\-hosted, and on\-premises business and operational systems. Integration patterns include APIs, web services, secure file exchanges, data transformations, event\-driven workflows, and other system\-to\-system interfaces. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** *Essential functions, as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include any of the following representative duties, knowledge, and skills. This is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and duties performed by incumbents of this class; employees may be assigned duties that are not listed below; reasonable accommodations will be made as required. The job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change at any time by the employer. Essential duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:* * Partner with stakeholders to elicit and refine business and technical requirements; convert them into target architecture, solution designs, and implementation plans. * Define, maintain, and advocate technology standards, reference architectures, and reusable patterns (security, integration, data, networking, cloud, observability, automation). * Produce architecture deliverables (diagrams, logical/physical models, interface contracts, data maps, migration plans, runbooks) and keep them current. * Guide solution delivery across the lifecycle: design reviews, configuration, integration, testing, change control, and readiness for operations; support post\-go\-live stabilization. * Embed security\-by\-design practices (identity, least privilege, encryption, hardening, monitoring) and ensure alignment with applicable compliance frameworks (e.g., CJIS, HIPAA, PCI). * Engineer for reliability, performance, capacity, and cost efficiency; leverage automation/IaC, scripting, and orchestration to reduce toil and improve consistency. * Contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity strategies, including backup, restore, failover, and resilience testing. * Evaluate and select products/services; manage technical aspects of vendor engagements and validate changes by contractors and service providers. * Mentor peers and provide technical leadership within and across teams; share knowledge through documentation, training, and communities of practice. * Create and/or oversee data flows, pipelines, and storage designs as needed to support analytics, reporting, integration, and operational use cases. * Participate in incident response for complex issues; drive root\-cause analysis and continuous improvement of standards and architectures. * Perform other duties as assigned. **MINIMUM** **QUALIFICATIONS:** **Education, Training, and Experience Guidelines** * Graduation with a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field OR four (4\) additional years of directly related experience in lieu of a degree. * Seven (7\)\+ years of progressive IT experience with at least three (3\) years in architecture, design, or senior engineering roles; Senior IT Architect typically ten (10\)\+ years with broad, multi\-domain experience. * A Master’s degree may substitute for up to two (2\) years of experience **Knowledge of:** * Enterprise platforms and practices across one or more domains: networks (LAN/WAN, wireless, firewalls, load balancers), cloud services (e.g., Microsoft Azure), virtualization, operating systems, AP web services, webhooks, messaging, secure file transfers, and other system\-to\-system integration methods**. * Experience with **data mapping, transformation, orchestration, workflow design, authentication, error handling, and integration security**. * Experience integrating **ERP, HRIS, financial, utility, asset management, public safety, customer service, or other enterprise line\-of\-business systems**. Experience with **Workday integrations** is highly desirable. * Experience designing integrations involving **Microsoft Azure services** and cloud\-based application architectures. * Experience supporting **production integrations**, including monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, exception handling, and recovery of failed transactions or data exchanges. * Ability to evaluate business processes and technical requirements and translate them into **scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable integration designs**. * Demonstrated ability to work directly with **business departments, application owners, subject\-matter experts, technical teams, and external vendors** to define requirements and deliver integrations from design through production support. * Ability to develop and maintain **integration architecture, interface specifications, data\-flow diagrams, technical documentation, and support procedures**. * Experience establishing or applying **integration architecture standards, reusable patterns, API conventions, security practices, and development standards** across an enterprise environment. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to understand **end\-to\-end business processes and data flows across multiple systems**. **PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS \& SOFT\-SKILL EVALUATION FACTORS** Technical skills remain primary; the following behaviors will be considered during performance evaluations for Architects and Senior Architects: * Positive Attitude \& Collaboration: Lifts others, recognizes contributions, and leads peers informally when needed. * Initiative \& Independence: Proactively solves problems, stays productive without close direction, and takes ownership for outcomes. * Adaptability \& Learning: Adapts to change, learns continuously, and embraces feedback. * Customer Support Mindset: Provides quality support to internal customers and partners; communicates clearly and respectfully. * Attentiveness \& Listening: Actively listens, seeks clarity, and contributes thoughtfully to discussions. * Leadership Behaviors (for senior roles): Vision, decision\-making, communication, empathy, accountability, innovation, conflict resolution, integrity, and strategic thinking. **LICENSES AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS** * Valid Class "C" Texas driver’s license required. Out\-of\-state license holders must have a valid license and provide a three\-year driving history. * One or more professional certifications relevant to assignment preferred (examples): Microsoft Azure (e.g., AZ 700/AZ\-305/AZ\-104\), AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, Cisco (e.g., CCNP/CCIE), Security\+ or equivalent; ITIL Foundation; PMP/Project\+; TOGAF. Time\-bounded certification requirements may be specified per posting. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT** Normal office environment with standing, sitting, walking, and standard computer use; occasional lifting, carrying, and on\-site work in datacenters or equipment rooms as needed. May require after\-hours work for changes, incidents, or maintenance. ***Candidates selected to move forward in the review process will be required to complete fingerprint screening to confirm eligibility for Criminal Justice Information System (CJIS) clearance, in addition to the standard pre‑employment process.*** **Hiring Range:** $96,536\.96 \- $120,931\.20, annually. **\#LoveWhereYouWork! Check out the benefits of working with us** **here.** Regular\-Full time*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

jobs.title: Construction Project Executive
jobs.description: **Construction Project Executive** Coakley \& Williams Construction (CWC) is seeking a Project Executive to lead our commercial construction projects while helping expand our portfolio. Building on CWCs established commercial business this leader will strengthen client relationships, develop new opportunities, and partner directly with the Business Unit Leaders and COO on pursuits and growth strategy. The role offers meaningful authority over project selection, staffing, and execution, with a potential path to Business Unit Leader or senior operations leadership. Expertise representing a general contractor on multiple base building, ground up, complex renovation and other related construction projects in excess of $20 Million in Value is necessary. **What Youll Do*** Provide executive leadership for multiple commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout. * Develop and maintain relationships with institutional owners, industry leaders, architects, engineers, consultants, and trade subcontractors. * Identify and advance new opportunities while serving as a final reviewer of project pursuits, proposals, RFP responses, and interview strategies. * Partner directly with the business leaders on growth strategy, market positioning, and pursuit decisions. * Lead project teams and oversee safety, scheduling, procurement, quality, risk, subcontractor performance, and client communication. * Manage budgets, forecasts, change orders, cost controls, owner requisitions, and overall project profitability. * Guide constructability, phasing, logistics, estimating, scheduling, BIM, and value\-management decisions during preconstruction. * Help select, mentor, and develop project team members with support from CWCs experienced Talent Acquisition team. * Represent CWC within higher education and construction industry organizations, conferences, and networking events. **What Sets This Opportunity Apart*** Build on an established commercial and related construction platform while helping shape CWCs growing portfolio. * Influence which projects CWC pursues and how teams are assembled to deliver them. * Work directly with the business unit leaders on business\-line strategy, client development, and long\-term growth. * Gain executive visibility and a potential path to Business Unit Leader or senior operations leadership. * Join a mid\-sized commercial general contractor where senior leaders have the resources to execute and the access to make an impact. **Required Qualifications*** At least ten (10\) years of experience in managing building construction projects singularly, or in cumulative, in excess of Twenty (20\) Million Dollars * Bachelors Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or Related field * Experience developing business and maintaining long\-term client relationships within the educational and institutional construction market * Proven track record of client satisfaction and profitability * OSHA 30 hour, First Aid and CPR certifications * LEED Specialty Accreditation * Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, Procore, Bluebeam as well as an understanding of Primavera scheduling and BIM **Preferred Experience*** Leadership of new construction, base building, renovation, reconstruction, or preconstruction projects for life science and/or related customers * An established network of institutional owners, facilities leaders, design partners, consultants, and industry professionals * Experience managing occupied campuses, phased construction, academic calendar constraints, and complex stakeholder groups **Job Demands**This position requires the ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, reach, and lift or move items weighing up to 50 pounds. Work may involve active construction sites, heavy equipment, hazardous materials, and extreme weather conditions. Hours will vary based on project requirements and may include nights and weekends. CWC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Project Manager – Data Modernization
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Cyberlocke, we design solutions for our clients’ most complex technology and data challenges. The Business Analyst will play a key role in supporting our Data Modernization clients by translating business needs into actionable data requirements, facilitating stakeholder discovery, improving data quality and governance, and helping guide the transformation of legacy and fragmented data environments into modern, scalable, analytics\-ready platforms. Our Values * Continuous Learning / Never Satisfied * Does the right thing (even when no one is watching) * Get things done / Reliable * Humble / Confident, with a "One Company" mindset * Helpful/Positive/Can\-do attitude We live our values with each other and with our customers. Our values guide us for how we hire, perform, and reward at Cyberlocke. This is an onsite position to start and will transfer to a hybrid position after 90 days. **Position Summary** Cyberlocke is seeking a **Business Analyst – Data Modernization** to support the planning, discovery, design, implementation, and adoption of enterprise data modernization initiatives. The Business Analyst serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and Cyberlocke's technical delivery teams, translating business objectives, operational processes, reporting requirements, data challenges, and compliance needs into clearly defined requirements that can be implemented by data architects, data engineers, analytics developers, governance specialists, cloud engineers, and other technical resources. This role is especially important during customer discovery and throughout implementation. The Business Analyst will help clients understand their current data environment, identify business and data requirements, document the desired future state, prioritize use cases, define acceptance criteria, facilitate stakeholder decisions, and ensure delivered solutions address measurable business outcomes. Cyberlocke's Data Modernization practice includes services involving Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, data integration and transformation, analytics and Power BI, data governance, data quality, cloud data platforms, AI readiness, security and compliance, and ongoing managed data operations. The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis capabilities with an understanding of modern data platforms, analytics, governance, and cloud technologies. **Key Responsibilities** **Business Discovery and Requirements Analysis** * Lead and facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements\-gathering meetings with client business and technical teams. * Develop a clear understanding of the client's business objectives, operational processes, data environment, reporting requirements, pain points, risks, and modernization goals. * Translate business needs into clear functional, data, analytics, reporting, governance, security, and operational requirements. * Identify and document business problems that can be addressed through improved data integration, automation, analytics, governance, or modernization. * Define business use cases and expected outcomes for modernization initiatives. * Identify stakeholder priorities and reconcile conflicting requirements between departments or business units. * Help customers distinguish between business requirements, technical requirements, and future\-state opportunities. * Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle. **Current\-State Assessment** * Assist with assessments of the client's current data ecosystem, including applications, data sources, databases, spreadsheets, reporting platforms, integrations, processes, and business workflows. * Document how information currently moves through the organization. * Identify manual processes, duplicate data entry, reporting inefficiencies, data silos, inconsistent business definitions, data ownership issues, and other operational challenges. * Assist technical teams in identifying source systems and understanding the business context of data contained within those systems. * Develop current\-state process flows, data\-flow documentation, business process maps, and stakeholder maps. * Help identify reporting and analytics dependencies that may be affected by modernization efforts. **Future\-State Data Modernization Planning** * Work with Cyberlocke solution architects and technical teams to translate business requirements into future\-state solution requirements. * Help define the customer's desired future\-state data operating model. * Participate in development of modernization roadmaps, implementation priorities, and phased delivery plans. * Assist customers in prioritizing data sources, reporting requirements, business domains, use cases, and analytics capabilities. * Support development of data modernization strategies involving Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, cloud data platforms, data integration, analytics, governance, and AI readiness. * Help define success criteria an ation. * Assist Project Managers in defining scope, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, and deliverables. * Identify scope changes and requirements that may impact project timelines, resources, or costs. * Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, project status meetings, and other Agile or project\-delivery activities as required. * Maintain requirements and business documentation throughout the project lifecycle. * Support transition from project implementation into operational or managed\-service support when applicable. **Customer Adoption and Change Management** * Identify business processes affected by the modernization initiative. * Help customers understand how new data capabilities will change existing workflows. * Assist in development of user documentation and training requirements. * Support stakeholder communication and adoption activities. * Help identify organizational barriers to adoption and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. * Assist customers with transitioning from legacy reporting and manual processes to new enterprise data and analytics capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * 3\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or similar role. * Experience gathering and documenting business and technical requirements. * Demonstrated ability to facilitate discovery sessions and stakeholder workshops. * Experience documenting business processes, functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Experience working with technical implementation teams. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical requirements. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong documentation and organizational skills. * Experience working with structured data, reporting, analytics, or business intelligence solutions. * Understanding of data integration, data quality, analytics, and data governance concepts. * Experience working with executive, business, and technical stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple requirements, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting data modernization, cloud migration, data warehouse, data lake, analytics, or digital\-transformation initiatives. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric. * Experience with Power BI. * Experience with Microsoft Azure data services. * Familiarity with OneLake, Lakehouse, data warehouse, Medallion architecture, and modern data\-platform concepts. * Familiarity with Microsoft Purview or other data\-governance technologies. * Understanding of ETL/ELT and data\-integration processes. * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL concepts. * Experience developing data dictionaries, business glossaries, or source\-to\-target mappings. * Experience with Agile/Scrum project delivery. * Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, or similar collaboration and project\-management platforms. * Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing technology environments. * Experience supporting enterprise organizations or public\-sector customers. * Familiarity with AI, machine learning, generative AI, and AI\-readiness concepts. **About Cyberlocke** Cyberlocke helps organizations modernize their technology and data environments so they can operate more efficiently, improve decision making, strengthen governance, and prepare for emerging AI capabilities. Our Data Modernization practice helps organizations transform fragmented data environments into governed, scalable, analytics\-ready platforms through cloud data architecture, integration, Microsoft Fabric, analytics, governance, security, AI readiness, and ongoing data\-platform operations.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: **Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** **10% Equity \| PropTech \+ AI \| Founding Team** **The Opportunity** **We are assembling the founding team behind a new company designed to challenge one of the largest and most established consumer industries in America.** **We aren’t ready to publicly share everything we’re building.** **But we can share the thesis:** **AI is about to dramatically change the economics of selling a home. We intend to be ahead of that change.** **We are building a national real estate platform that combines AI\-powered listing technology, transparent flat\-fee services, and an optional layer of in\-person support into a fundamentally different consumer experience.** **Not another lead\-generation company.** **Not another CRM.** **Not another slightly cheaper version of a traditional brokerage.** **Something different.** **And we’re looking for the Founding CTO who wants to build it with us.** **Why This Is Interesting** **Most startups entering real estate eventually encounter the same problem:** **They can build the technology.** **They can raise money.** **They can generate demand.** **But actually operating a brokerage nationally introduces an enormous regulatory and licensing challenge.** **We have an opportunity to approach the market with licensing capabilities across all 50 states from the beginning.** **That changes what can be built.** **Instead of proving a concept in one state and spending years assembling the infrastructure required to expand, our ambition is national from day one.** **Combine that with experienced leadership, strong sales capabilities, direct industry knowledge and a business model that has already attracted significant interest from venture capital, private industry and strategic players, and we believe the ingredients exist to build something unusually large.** **What We’re Building** **We won’t publish the entire product roadmap here.** **The broader vision is straightforward:** **Flat\-fee real estate \+ AI listing technology \+ optional in\-person services.** **We believe homeowners should be able to use technology to handle significantly more of the home\-selling process themselves while having professional assistance available exactly when they need it.** **That means rethinking the entire experience rather than simply digitizing the traditional one.** **The technology could ultimately touch areas including:** **\* AI\-assisted property listing** **\* Pricing and market intelligence** **\* Listing distribution** **\* Marketing automation** **\* Transaction management** **\* Consumer guidance** **\* Showing coordination** **\* Document workflows** **\* Communications** **\* Brokerage operations** **\* Marketplace/service infrastructure** **\* Local, on\-demand assistance** **Some of what we intend to build is obvious.** **Some of it isn’t.** **The latter is a major reason we’re intentionally keeping this description broad.** **Your Role** **You would join as our Founding Chief Technology Officer and a true equity partner.** **This is not a position where someone else hands you a finished product specification and asks you to manage engineers.** **You will help determine what the product becomes.** **You’ll work directly with the founding team to translate a significant industry opportunity into a technology platform capable of operating nationally.** **Early on, you’ll be a builder.** **You’ll architect.** **You’ll prototype.** **You’ll write code.** **You’ll experiment with AI.** **You’ll decide what we build internally and what we integrate.** **You’ll probably kill some ideas and discover better ones.** **As the company grows, you’ll build the engineering organization around the architecture and technical vision you helped establish.** **The Technical Challenge** **We aren’t looking to sprinkle AI on top of an existing brokerage model and call it innovation.** **The question we’re interested in is much larger:** **If you were designing the process of selling a home today, with modern AI, automation and software available from the beginning, how much of the traditional model would you actually recreate?** **That’s the problem we want our CTO thinking about.** **The platform will require a combination of sophisticated consumer software, AI systems, real estate data, APIs, transaction infrastructure, brokerage operations and automation.** **And there is substantial room for the CTO to influence how those pieces come together.** **Who We’re Looking For** **We’re looking for a technical founder, not simply an employee with a CTO title.** **Someone who can move between architecture and execution.** **Someone who can build the first version and eventually recruit the people capable of building the hundredth.** **Experience with several of the following would be valuable:** **\* Full\-stack application development** **\* AI/LLM systems** **\* Agentic AI and automation** **\* API architecture** **\* Cloud infrastructure** **\* Data\-intensive applications** **\* SaaS platforms** **\* Marketplaces** **\* FinTech or PropTech** **\* Payments** **\* Security and privacy** **\* Real estate/MLS data** **\* Scaling engineering organizations** **Real estate experience is helpful, but not necessary.** **The ability to build quickly, think independently and recognize enormous technical leverage is.** **Why Join Now?** **Because the most interesting time to join a company isn’t after everything is obvious.** **It’s before.** **The founding team brings experience across real estate, brokerage operations, strategy, sales, marketing, product development and company growth.** **We have a significant structural advantage that would be difficult for a new entrant to reproduce quickly.** **We have a defined market thesis.** **We have a clear vision.** **And we are intentionally leaving one major seat at the founding table open:** **Technology.** **The person who fills it won’t inherit the technical strategy.** **They’ll create it.** **Compensation** **This is an equity\-first founding opportunity.** **Founding CTO Equity: 10%** **That’s meaningful ownership because we want meaningful commitment.** **We aren’t looking for someone to spend a few hours each week advising us from the sidelines. We want someone who wants to become one of the people who built the company.** **The equity structure would be formally documented with appropriate founder vesting and protections.** **As funding and/or revenue support it, the position is intended to evolve into a compensated executive role while retaining the CTO’s meaningful ownership position.** **The Bigger Picture** **The residential real estate industry represents an enormous amount of consumer spending.** **Technology has changed almost everything surrounding the transaction.** **Search changed.** **Marketing changed.** **Mortgage technology changed.** **Consumer behavior changed.** **And now AI is changing what consumers can reasonably do for themselves.** **We believe that creates a window for a very different kind of real estate company.** **One that combines technology, national brokerage infrastructure and real\-world services rather than choosing between them.** **We have a very specific vision for what that company can become.** **We’re intentionally not putting all of it in a job posting.** **If you’re the kind of technical founder who sees a massive legacy industry and immediately starts wondering how much of it can be rebuilt, we’d like to show you the rest.** Employment Type Pay: $60\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Expected hours: 1\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Founding AI Research Lead - Agentic AI Lab
jobs.description: **Founding AI Research Lead \- Agentic AI Lab** *San Francisco Bay Area \| Full time* Backed by 8VC, we are building a world\-class team to tackle one of industry's most critical problems: trusted AI for enterprise operations. **About the Role** Fabrion is designing the future of enterprise AI infrastructure, grounded in agents, knowledge graphs, and multi\-tenant governance. We are working on research inside the Agentic AI Lab to train and evaluate specialized models for mission\-critical enterprise work. The direction is specific and ambitious. We share the full thesis under NDA during the interview process. What we can say here: the program has committed design partners with production data access, dedicated compute, a benchmark\-first plan with clear go and no\-go gates, and a platform team that has already built the governance and serving layer your models will run behind. This is full\-cycle research: problem formulation, data, training, evaluation, and deployment, with your name on the results. **Core Responsibilities** * Own the research agenda: model and training design, evaluation protocol, and the publication plan * Take models from public benchmark results to live customer shadow deployments, with gates you define and defend * Set the benchmark discipline: strong baselines first, published comparables cited, results that survive scrutiny * Lead and grow a small team (ML engineer, data engineer, contractors) and pair closely with the founders and platform team * Write technical plans internally and papers externally when results warrant it **Desired Experience** * Hands\-on experience training sequence models, owning the tokenizer, the training loop, and the evaluation, not only fine\-tuning through APIs * Strong background in at least two of: reinforcement learning (especially offline and imitation settings), sequence decision modeling, structured or constrained generation, learning from event and log data * A track record of shipping research into a product or landing a rigorous benchmark result * PhD in machine learning or a closely related field, or an equivalent research record * Preferred Tech Stack * PyTorch, the Hugging Face ecosystem, experiment tracking and reproducible training pipelines, modern cloud data warehouses, evaluation harness engineering **Soft Skills \& Mindset** * Comfortable as the most senior researcher in the room: setting direction under ambiguity and writing decisions down * Rigor over hype: you distrust your own results until the baselines agree * A teacher's instinct: part of this role is turning strong engineers into researchers **Why This Role Matters** We believe specialized models built on governed enterprise data can run real, multi\-billion\-dollar workflows. Your work will not be buried in research reports. It will be benchmarked in public, deployed to real customers, and activated by hundreds of thousands of decisions.

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **GENESIS HEALTHCARE SYSTEM** ============================= In order to fill our Mission of serving our community by helping each person achieve optimal health and well\-being by providing compassionate, exceptional, and affordable healthcare services, all employees of Genesis HealthCare System must be committed to living the Genesis Mission and Genesis values of Compassion, Excellence, Integrity, Team, and Innovation. All employees must regard themselves as an ‘owner’ of Genesis and keep our patients at the center of everything we do *\- always.* **Position Details:** --------------------- Work Shift: Day Shift (United States of America) Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 Department: IT Business \& Ancillary Services Overview of Position: Under general supervision, the Clinical Systems Engineer manages the implementation, configuration, documentation, and initial testing of networked medical devices integrated with the Electronic Medical Record system. This role serves as the technical liaison between IT and Biomed, supporting medical device integration projects involving operating systems, system administration, interfaces, software applications, and network security. The position provides technical analysis and troubleshooting support for medical equipment connectivity issues while ensuring appropriate coordination, documentation, and collaboration across internal teams and external vendors. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES** 1\. Manage networked medical device integration projects, including new installations, upgrades, updates, replacements, and related project documentation. 2\. Define project scope, resource needs, timelines, technical specifications, and cost estimates in coordination with IT, Biomed, vendors, and organizational stakeholders. 3\. Coordinate project meetings, vendor activities, milestones, and deliverables to ensure timely completion from initiation through implementation. 4\. Serve as the primary liaison between IT and Biomed, supporting workflows in ServiceNow and Biomed CMMS to ensure accurate technical documentation and ongoing support. 5\. Coordinate and support clinical medical device infrastructure, including segmented clinical networks, interfaces, servers, and related systems. 6\. Provide initial IT technical review and troubleshooting support for networked medical equipment connectivity, integration, and operational issues. 7\. Oversee vendor work on medical device servers and ensure activities align with IT, Biomed, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements. 8\. Support cybersecurity, compliance, and operational readiness activities for medical device servers and related infrastructure. 9\. Partner with management and end users to define maintenance approaches, service requirements, and support standards for assigned technologies. 10\. Analyze assigned systems and processes to identify improvement opportunities, recommend best practices, and implement leadership\-approved changes. **QUALIFICATIONS** 1\. Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering, information technology, a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience is required. 2\. Three to five years of clinical engineering and/or information technology support experience is required, including at least three years of technology support experience in health care. 3\. Ability to troubleshoot system integration technologies, including networking, HL7, FHIR, and APIs. 4\. Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and project management skills. 5\. Ability to work independently and under pressure in a complex and changing environment. 6\. Working knowledge of clinical equipment regulatory standards, hospital design, and applicable building codes and regulations. 7\. Working knowledge of information technology for clinical applications, including data storage, redundancy, backups, and recovery. 8\. Ability to supervise vendor implementations. 9\. Highly effective written and verbal communication and leadership skills. **PATIENT CENTERED CARE \& BEHAVIORAL EXPECTATIONS** 1\. Living the Genesis Mission, Vision and Values: * Performs work in a manner that is quality focused. * Treats patients, co\-workers, visitors and volunteers with courtesy, compassion, empathy and respect. * Results oriented and focused on achievement of objectives. * Acknowledges and responds to the diversity of people and the situation. * Encourages peers (others) to be owners of change. * Always makes the effort to anticipate and exceed customer needs and expectations. * Possesses the ability to engage others with patience and understanding. * Acts in a manner that creates positive first and lasting impressions. * Demonstrates the ability to own issues until they are resolved. 2\. Patient Centered Care (patients/families, physicians, co\-workers, all other internal/external customers) * Introduces self and role…connects with everyone. * Communicates effectively (i.e. advising others of actions, pertinent information, time durations, etc.) and asks for feedback. * Asks for and anticipates needs and concerns of others. * Maintains a positive work environment for staff and a healing environment for patients (i.e. safe, clean, quiet, etc.) * Maintains the dignity and privacy of each person; manages confidential/sensitive information appropriately. * Responds to requests in an appropriate and timely manner. * Exits patient/customer encounters courteously, asking if there are additional needs that can be addressed. 3\. Promotes Patient and Employee Safety * Demonstrates safe Patient Handling (i.e. transfers, transport, care administration, nutrition, medication, etc.) * Demonstrates safe Materials Handling (i.e. appropriate use and disposal of chemicals, infectious wastes, etc.) * Demonstrates appropriate knowledge of Infectious Disease precautions and use of proper protective equipment * Demonstrates Slips/Trips and Falls Awareness. * Actively contributes to maintaining a safe, clean and quiet environment. **WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 1\. Input and review data through a personal computer (PC) 2\. Read, write and utilize manual and computerized systems and documentation 3\. Collect data, interpret findings, set priorities and carry out established plans. 4\. Regularly lift and/or move 25 lbs. 5\. Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. This description reflects in general terms the type and level of work performed. It is not intended to be all\-inclusive, nor portray the specific duties of any one incumbent. **Thank you for your interest in employment at Genesis. Genesis is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. Selection of applicants for employment is based only on qualifications and the requirements of a specific job.**

jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Pflugerville, TX, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; Red Oak, TX, USA; Houston, TX, USA; Pryor Creek, OK, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5 years of experience as a program manager or technical program manager. * 5 years of experience in controls engineering, automation, or systems integration within industrial or mission\-critical environments. * 5 years of experience in BMS/EPMS architectures (including DDC, PLC, virtual machines, and SCADA systems) and with communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP. * Ability to travel 50% of the time to provide on\-site support across various project locations. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems to facilitate effective cross\-discipline collaboration. * Ability to trace a failure from a software dashboard back to a physical wiring or sensor issue in the field. * Ability to translate complex automation logic into clear instructions for field technicians and electrical contractors. * Ability to focus on "point\-to\-point" accuracy to ensure 100% data integrity for the facility’s monitoring systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. As the primary on\-site technical authority for automation, you will ensure that the "brains" of the facility the integration of mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems are installed and networked to perfection. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide design development oversight and ensure owner’s requirements are met, act as the definitive resource for integrators and contractors to resolve ambiguities in sequence of operations (SOO), IOLs, and network topology diagrams. * Perform periodic site walk\-throughs to verify the physical installation, ensuring correct placement for accurate readings. * Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and field conditions to prevent commissioning delays, ensuring hardware matches programmed logic. * Ensure all installations meet local electrical codes, cybersecurity hardening standards, Google standards, and project\-specific automation requirements. * Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Teams for resolution of sequence issues, controls intent and changes to the SOO during the construction process. We produce innovative and mission\-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. As an early member of this growing technical team, the engineer will have meaningful hands\-on ownership from concept and CAD design through manufacturing readiness and commercialization. The role will work closely with electrical engineering, applications engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, project management, sales, and the Sidney plant to ensure solutions meet both customer requirements and manufacturing needs. The ideal candidate brings mechanical design experience in power generation, large industrial equipment, modular systems, or complex packaged equipment. Experience with generator packaging or containerization, large diesel generators, 2MW\+ systems, cooling systems, fuel tanks, enclosures, or applicable UL requirements is especially valuable. For an engineer who wants to do more than support an established product line, this is an opportunity to help build one from the ground up—with significant technical ownership, strong company investment, and meaningful growth potential. **Responsibilities:** Mechanical Design \& Engineering* Design containerized and modular power generation solutions for data center backup and prime power applications. * Develop 3D models, detailed drawings, assemblies, fabrication packages, and engineering documentation using CAD software. * Design and integrate: + Generator enclosures and power modules + ISO container\-based power systems + Structural support systems and equipment skids + Fuel storage and fuel delivery systems + Air intake and exhaust systems + Ventilation and cooling systems + Acoustic attenuation systems + Fire protection interfaces + Service access and maintenance provisions * Perform engineering calculations related to structural integrity, airflow, cooling performance, vibration, noise attenuation, and equipment support. Data Center Solutions Engineering* Design power generation enclosures and modules to support mission\-critical data center applications. * Ensure equipment layouts support uptime, maintainability, safe operations, and rapid serviceability. * Collaborate with customers and internal teams to develop custom solutions that meet data center site constraints and operational requirements. * Support designs for N, N\+1, and 2N redundancy architectures. * Evaluate and optimize designs for deployment within hyperscale and colocation environments. Thermal Management \& Coo qualification of mechanical components and assemblies. Customer \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration* Collaborate with electrical, controls, acoustics, and thermal engineering teams to ensure complete system integration. * Participate in technical reviews with customers, consultants, contractors, and suppliers. * Support sales and project teams with technical evaluations, proposals, and feasibility assessments. * Assist field service organizations with troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline. * 3\+ years of progressive mechanical development design experience ideally in power generation, industrial equipment, modular systems, heavy equipment, or related industries. * 2\+ years experience with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, Inventor, or similar platforms, with bility to develop engineering documentation and manufacturing drawings. * 2\+ years of demonstrated knowledge in: + Structural design + Sheet metal fabrication + Welded assemblies + Airflow and ventilation systems + Thermal management principles + Mechanical packaging concepts **Core Competencies** * Power generation equipment packaging * Containerized power solutions * Structural and mechanical design * Thermal management systems * Airflow and ventilation engineering * Acoustic engineering and noise reduction * Fuel system integration * Vibration isolation * Design for manufacturability (DFM) * Reliability and maintainability engineering * Data center infrastructure requirements * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. **Preferences:*** 5\+ years of experience in power generation, mission\-critical infrastructure, modular construction, or data center industries. * Experience designing: + Generator enclosures + Containerized equipment packages + Cooling systems + Fuel systems + Acoustic attenuation solutions * Familiarity with finite element analysis (FEA) and computational fluid dynamics (CFD). * Knowledge of ISO container standards and transportation requirements. * Experience supporting hyperscale data center customers. * Understanding of engine cooling systems, exhaust systems, and vibration isolation. * Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification. **Travel \& Work Arrangements*** Position is based onsite in Sidney, OH * Standard work hours 8:00 am \- 5:00 pm Pay Range The base pay range for this role is $100,000 \- $130,000 annually. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. **What We Offer** At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well\-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond. Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.
