jobs.description: **Lead Complex Marine Construction Projects with Lancaster’s Custom Dock \& Lift Systems!** **Job Title:** Sr. Project Manager**Company Name**: Lancaster’s Custom Dock \& Lift Systems, Inc.**Salary:** $85,000 – $120,000 per year depending on experience, plus bonus opportunities**Industry:** Marine Construction / Heavy Civil Construction**Location:** Troutman, NC **Job Overview** Lancaster’s Custom Dock \& Lift Systems, Inc. is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to oversee technically complex marine construction projects performed on or over water. This is not a commercial building construction role. We are seeking a seasoned professional with a strong background in dock structures, marine construction, dredging, and shoreline or seawall installation and removal. Our projects require precision planning, marine logistics coordination, and hands\-on leadership in challenging environments. The ideal candidate has successfully managed operations from floating equipment, understands heavy civil risk management, and thrives in demanding marine construction settings. **Who We Are** Lancaster’s Custom Dock \& Lift Systems, Inc. is a leader in marine construction specializing in the design, construction, and maintenance of high\-quality dock systems, marina structures, and shoreline stabilization projects. Our team is known for delivering technically demanding projects with precision, safety, and craftsmanship. Working with Lancaster’s means joining a team that values innovation, expertise, and collaboration while building durable waterfront infrastructure for residential, commercial, and marina clients. **Key Responsibilities*** Lead full lifecycle management of marine construction projects from preconstruction planning through project closeout * Oversee projects involving residential docks, private marina slips, and commercial marine structures * Develop and manage detailed work plans, cost structures, baseline schedules, and recovery schedules * Supervise deep\-water operations, including pile driving (steel, concrete, and timber) * Manage marine logistics including barges, cranes, floating equipment, and specialty marine access systems * Coordinate work sequencing across navigable waterways and challenging marine environments * Direct collaboration between field leadership, engineering teams, subcontractors, and property owners * Maintain strict financial oversight including including county and state permitting offices, Duke Energy, DOT, USACE, and marine authorities * Travel to active marine construction sites up to 75% as required **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related technical field * Minimum 5\+ years of project management experience in marine structural or infrastructure construction * Experience managing projects involving: * Marine substructures and superstructures * Dock and marina construction * Barge terminal construction * Deep foundation systems and pile\-supported structures * Strong knowledge of marine construction methods, including work from floating platforms and temporary work in water * Experience managing public and private infrastructure contracts with complex regulatory ability to lead field teams in high\-risk marine environments * Excellent communication skills with the ability to interface with owners, engineers, inspectors, and executive leadership **Benefits*** vision insurance * 401(k) retirement savings plan * Paid time off including holidays and vacation * Professional development and certification support * Strong team environment and opportunities for This role is based in Troutman, NC, with travel required to active marine construction job sites as projects demand. ***Equal Employment Opportunity****Lancaster’s Custom Dock \& Lift Systems, Inc. is jobs.title: Agent Reliability Engineer, GTM
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production\-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open\-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M\+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000\+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (\+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. **About The Team:** ------------------- GTM Engineering builds the AI agents, systems, and automation that power how our go\-to\-market teams work. We partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and other GTM functions to identify high\-leverage problems and build solutions that improve speed, quality, and scale. Our work spans four core areas: * Identify — find high\-leverage GTM workflows where AI can meaningfully improve how we operate * Build — design, build, and deploy production AI agents and automated workflows across GTM * Enable — drive adoption through thoughtful rollouts, playbooks, best practices, and ongoing enablement * Evangelize — share what we build and learn externally through content, demos, talks, and open source examples **About The Role:** ------------------- You'll own the health, cost, performance, and business impact of the GTM Agent, and build the feedback loops that keep it improving. Because we build the platform we run on, you'll also operate the agent on LangSmith the way we tell customers to, and turn that practice into the reference story enterprises keep asking us for. *You'll work across Python 3\.11, FastAPI, LangGraph, DeepAgents, LangSmith, Supabase Postgres, BigQuery, Anthropic and OpenAI models, and Slack and Next.js surfaces.* **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Monitor production health across every graph, catching errors, slow runs, expensive runs, and silent failures before reps report them * Triage incoming issues from Slack, tickets, and rep reports, fixing small things directly and routing the rest to the right owner * Run the weekly eval suite, investigate failures, and turn real production bugs into permanent regression tests * Track cost and latency by model, graph, use case, and role, and recommend concrete changes to model choice, reasoning effort, and caching * Track usage and adoption per rep and per feature, and own the weekly health report the team runs on * Build the business metrics that show leadership what the agent is worth, from reply rates and meetings booked to hours reclaimed and ROI * Build our own monitoring and alerting on LangSmith, and write the “how we run our own agent” story for customers **What You'll Bring:** ---------------------- * Strong production Python and SQL, comfortable working in traces, logs, and warehouse tables * Real experience running LLM applications, including tracing, evals, and prompt and cache mechanics * SRE or production operations instincts: percentiles, SLOs, and separating noise from real pattern * Healthy skepticism about metrics; you check what a number actually counts before you publish it * Clear writing, and interest in publishing what you learn * High agency; you notice what's missing and take initiative to build it **Nice to Haves:** ------------------ * LangGraph or LangSmith experience * Experience building an eval suite from scratch * BigQuery or dbt * Prior DevRel\-adjacent writing * Empathy for sales and go\-to\-market users Salary: $150,000 \- $190,000 **Compensation Philosophy:** We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. **Benefits** ============ Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in\-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: The 30\-second version LeadrPro is a B2B marketplace where software sellers meet verified, paid buyers. Our AI agent, LP, now lives inside our customers' Slack workspaces — surfacing matched buyers, drafting outreach, triaging demo requests, and pushing meeting prep into the channels where their teams already work. Every customer's Slack agent is only as good as the prompts behind it. Right now, a human has to sit with each account, learn their ICP, their voice, and their sales motion, and tune the agent until it earns its place in the channel. **That human is you.** You'll be embedded with real revenue teams, writing and testing the prompts that make their agents useful — then turning what works into templates so the next 100 customers get it in an hour instead of a week. This is not a research role. You will talk to customers. You will ship on day three. What you'll actually do **Onboard customer agents.** Run configuration sessions with new accounts, extract their ICP, tone, product positioning, and edge cases, and translate all of it into working system prompts and tool configurations for their Slack agent. **Write, break, and fix prompts.** Draft prompts, build small eval sets from real customer scenarios, run them, find where the agent hallucinates, over\-hedges, or sounds like a robot, and fix it. Version everything. Document why each change worked. **Own the feedback loop.** Read agent transcripts. Find the recurring failure modes across accounts. Bring the top three to the product team every Friday with a proposed fix, not just a complaint. **Turn one\-offs into product.** The job is to make yourself unnecessary. Every bespoke prompt you write should end up as a reusable template, a variable, or an onboarding question. We measure you on how much of your work stops being manual. **Be the customer's person.** When an account says "the agent isn't getting it," you're the one who responds, diagnoses, and closes the loop — usually the same day. What good looks like **Day 30** — You've onboarded 5\+ customer agents end to end without a hand on your shoulder. You've built our first shared eval set. **Day 60** — Median time\-to\-first\-value for a new Slack agent is under 24 hours, down from where we started. You've published a prompt library the rest of the team uses. **Day 90** — At least 60% of new agent configurations are handled by templates you built, not by a person. You've shipped at least one prompt change that measurably lifted a customer metric — reply rate, meetings booked, or agent messages actually acted on. Who this is for * You've built something real with an LLM API — a side project, a tool, an automation. Not a certificate. A thing that ran. * You write clearly. Prompt engineering is 80% writing, and vague writers produce vague agents. * You can read and edit JSON, understand what a tool call is, and debug why one failed. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can't be afraid of a terminal. * You're comfortable on a Zoom with a VP of Sales who is skeptical of AI and short on time. * You're allergic to leaving a problem half\-diagnosed. Who this isn't for * Anyone who wants to "explore AI strategy." We need output, not frameworks. * Anyone who needs a spec before starting. You'll get a customer, a goal, and a deadline. * Anyone who would rather not talk to customers. Half this job is listening. Bonus points Experience with Slack's API or bot framework · evals or LLM observability tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, or homegrown) · B2B SaaS or sales ops background · you've worked a quota\-carrying or SDR seat and know why sellers ignore tools Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: ### **General Information** Req \# WD00104316 Career area: Artificial Intelligence Country/Region: United States of America State: North Carolina City: Morrisville Date: Sunday, September 6, 2026 Working time: Full\-time **Additional Locations**: * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville ### **Why Work at Lenovo** We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked \#153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full\-stack portfolio of AI\-enabled, AI\-ready, and AI\-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world\-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. ### **Description and Requirements** **Global Future Leaders Program: Start Strong. Lead Early.** ------------------------------------------------------------ The Lenovo Global Future Leaders Program is a highly selective program designed to develop Lenovo's next generation of business and technology leaders. Created for exceptional graduates, the program provides accelerated development opportunities for individuals ready to grow their careers and make an impact at one of the world's leading technology companies. As a Global Future Leader, you'll gain hands\-on experience through challenging assignments and rotational opportunities across Lenovo. You'll collaborate with teams and leaders around the world, building a broad understanding of our organization while developing the skills needed to create meaningful impact. During your first three years, you'll participate in cross\-functional experiences, strategic projects, leadership development, and mentorship opportunities designed to accelerate your growth. From day one, you'll take on meaningful work, gain exposure to senior leaders, and help drive innovative solutions that deliver smarter technology for all. We're looking for ambitious problem\-solvers, innovative thinkers, and future leaders who are energized by technology, embrace new challenges, and are eager to make an impact. ### **What You Can Expect** * **Cross\-functional rotational experiences** across Lenovo's business, providing broad exposure and diverse career experiences * **Meaningful business impact from day one** through strategic projects and real\-world challenges * **Exposure to senior leaders** along with structured leadership development and mentorship * **Collaboration with global teams and stakeholders** across one of the world's leading technology companies * **Accelerated career growth** through innovation, continuous learning, and opportunities to influence the future of smarter technology for all In This Global Future Leader role, You will act as an **AI Solution Analyst** **Role Overview** In this role, you will report to the Solutions \& Services Group (SSG) Customer Service AI Solution (CSAS) Director, supporting enterprise customers across key global markets. You will join Lenovo’s CSAS team, an innovative organization delivering enterprise\-grade, infrastructure\-agnostic Agentic AI platforms that transform global customer service operations. In this versatile hybrid position spanning Technical Pre\-Sales, R\&D Solution Development, and Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will take part in collaborative planning sessions, customer discovery workshops, and solution sprint reviews to master and deploy our award\-winning CSAS platform. **What You’ll Do** * Technical Pre\-Sales \& Live Demos: Support customer\-facing technical discussions, configure and deliver live demos, and help articulate CSAS platform capabilities to both technical and business stakeholders. * Customer Workflow Discovery: Participate in discovery workshops to understand current customer service workflows, identify pain points, and map opportunities for AI\-driven transformation. * R\&D \& Platform Enhancement: Collaborate with the R\&D team to refine and extend CSAS platform features based on real\-world customer requirements and feedback. * Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE): Work hands\-on with customers to configure, integrate, and customize CSAS solutions in on\-site or remote deployment scenarios. * Proof of Concept (PoC) Execution: Help design, build, and val te customer workflows and business problems into AI\-driven architectures, PoCs, and production implementations. * How to work at the intersection of technical pre\-sales, software engineering, and forward deployed engineering in a fast\-moving AI environment. * How to communicate AI and LLM architectures clearly to executives, business stakeholders, and technical teams. * How to instrument, measure, and communicate AI\-driven value using KPIs tied to customer service operations and business impact. **Job Requirements:** **Must Have** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative engineering discipline from an accredited University (recent / fresh graduate). * Core Software Engineering: Solid hands\-on programming proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and SQL, with foundational knowledge of RESTful API design and data integration pipelines. * AI \& LLM Foundations: Clear understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts. * Communication \& Storytelling: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical AI architectures to both technical engineers and business executives. * Adaptability \& Drive: Strong analytical problem\-solving mindset with a willingness to operate across customer\-facing pre\-sales, hands\-on coding, and on\-site/remote client implementations. **Nice to Have** * Exposure to modern AI agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Familiarity with enterprise SaaS developer platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes). * Internship or project experience involving AI/ML models, Natural Language Processing (NLP), or conversational AI platforms. * Multilingual skills (e.g., Mandarin) to facilitate collaboration across global R\&D hubs and regional delivery teams. **GLF Program Requirements*** Currently completing or recently completed a degree from an accredited university (Bachelors, Masters or PhD) * Passion for technology, innovation, and continuous learning * Demonstrated leadership potential through academic, professional, internship, or community involvement * Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem\-solving capabilities * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and work effectively across global teams * Ability jobs.description: **Job Summary:** This manager is responsible for leading the day\-to\-day operations of our 24x7x365 Network Operations Center (NOC), including its staff, tools, and processes. Duties/Responsibilities:** * Supervise a team of NOC technicians and engineers, including scheduling shifts, assigning tasks, and ensuring adequate coverage. * Ensure constant monitoring of the network and systems, responding to all alerts and incidents according to established protocols. * Oversee the incident response process, including initial triage, troubleshooting, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams like engineering and security for advanced issues (Tier 2 and 3 escalations). * Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and post\-incident reviews to identify systemic issues and prevent future occurrences. * Provide regular reports on network performance, incident metrics, and service level agreement (SLA) compliance to senior management. **Strategy and Planning:** * Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures and escalation protocols to standardize operations and improve efficiency. * Plan for network enhancements, capacity upgrades, and technology roadmaps to support business growth and changing demands. * Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices to ensure continuous improvement. **Leadership and Team Management:** * Hire, train, and mentor NOC staff, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning. * Conduct performance evaluations, provide feedback, and support the professional development of team members. * Maintain a strong, collaborative team environment, effectively managing a diverse and potentially distributed team. **Communication and Vendor Relations:** * Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external communications during major network outages or incidents. * Liaise with vendors, internet service providers (ISPs), and managed service providers (MSPs) to resolve network issues and enforce service level agreements. * Ensure clear and timely communication with other IT departments, business units, and executive leadership on operational status. **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Strong knowledge of networking technologies, protocols (including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF), and hardware (routers, switches, firewalls). * Strong understanding of DWDM (Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing), OTN, fiber optic characterization, optical power levels, and transport network topologies. * Proficiency with network monitoring tools such as Netcool and Zabbix. * Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools like ServiceNow or Jira for incident management and ticketing. * Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. * This is a hands\-on technical role for candidates passionate about architecture, RTL build, IP integration, debugging, and pre/post\-silicon support. **Key Responsibilities** * Analyze hardware and software interaction at the system level to identify bottlenecks in existing AI/ML workloads and HBM\-based hardware. * Drive future HBM architecture, design, and technology to address bottlenecks, including implementing proof of concept designs. * Architect, design and implement RTL for SoC‑level blocks and subsystems used in HBM logic die. * Architect and design memory sub\-systems including memory IP selection and integration, bus and protocol selection, and power/performance/area optimization. * Integrate internal and third‑party IP (e.g., controllers, microcontrollers, NOC, RAS, MBIST, interfaces, adapters, buffers, PHY‑adjacent logic). * Translate architectural and micro‑architectural specifications into high‑quality RTL implementations. * Participate in SoC‑level integration activities, including clocking, reset, power intent, and configuration infrastructure. * Assist with pre‑silicon validation and post‑silicon bring‑up, including root‑cause analysis of silicon issues. ensure robust and manufacturable builds. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a minimum of 10 years of experience in a related field. * Proficiency in SystemVerilog/Verilog and familiarity with SoC integration methodologies. * Experience with the RTL‑to‑GDS flow, including synthesis, static timing analysis, and develop sign‑off considerations. * Familiarity with EDA tools from Cadence, Synopsys, and/or Siemens. * Programming or scripting experience (e.g., Python, TCL, Perl, or shell scripting). **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with HBM, DRAM, or memory‑centric SoC designs. * Familiarity with high‑speed interfaces, clocking strategies, reset architectures, and power management jobs.title: Firmware Test Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!** At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in\-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence. Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest\-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE . The Firmware Test Engineering Manager will be a technical lead in the development and execution of test strategies for new firmware architectures, applications, components, and libraries to ensure on\-time delivery and requirements are met. You will also lead a medium size team of engineers to support the testing of embedded systems. You will interface with electronic hardware design and other cross\-functional teams to understand system design requirements and translate them into testable requirements. **You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:** * Lead the design, development, execution, and troubleshooting efforts for test procedures related to firmware features, applications, and subsystems of mid to high level complexity. * Lead the design, review, and refinement of engineering requirements for test needs. * Lead peer\-review of test designs and automation. * Develop test plans and drive consensus to enable the delivery of firmware that meets all requirements by testing. * Lead agile project teams through the new product development process. * Drive continuous improvement efforts of test development. * Champion experiments using simulations and other methods to draw concise, logical conclusions by analyzing data. * Use agile methods to break down tasks, assign work, provide estimates, drive critical milestones, and track progress to ensure adherence to schedule and Milwaukee Tool’s processes. * Lead technical meetings, develop, and give formal technical presentations, and lead a small technical team. * Quickly, effectively, and candidly frame\-up and escalate business risks/opportunities to senior leadership. * Effectively communicate and motivate up, down and across the organization to a diverse range of technical and non\-technical team members. * Drive urgency in project schedules and accountability for establishing and achieving key project metrics that meet the organization’s needs. **What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. * 7\+ years of experience with verification/validation testing, hardware in the loop (HIL) testing, embedded systems and/or PCBA design. * Ability to read schematics and component data sheets, along with a proficient understanding of digital circuits to understand the interaction between firmware and electronics. * Proficient in using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, e\-loads, data acquisition systems, multimeters, power analyzers, etc. * Experience with National Instrument hardware, Test Stand, and/or LabView for automated testing (Development or Execution). * Experience using a scripting language (Python, C\#, or C/C\+\+ etc.) to create automated tests. * Practical experience leading through all aspects of the software development lifecycle. * 3\+ years of leadership or project management experience with demonstrated ability to partner across discipline and organizational boundaries to develop and execute project plans. * Proficient using tools required for software configuration management, requirements management, defect tracking, and peer review. * Practical experience with DevOps, automated testing, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD). * Good understanding of various testing methodologies. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, exercises independent judgement, and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment. * Self\-motivated, organized, efficient, and process oriented. * Strong communication skills (verbal and written). * Ability to travel up to 10% (Domestic and International). **Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:** * Exposure to bare\-metal firmware design. **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. * Generous 401 (K) savings plan. * Education assistance. * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service. * And many more, check out our benefits site HERE . *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Senior .Net Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview:** As a .NET Engineer you will drive the technical modernization of a large\-scale system from .NET Framework 4\.8 to .NET 10\. Your work will span the full backend stack — replacing Windows\-only dependencies, refactoring legacy patterns, migrating data access to EF Core, and ensuring every service is portable, containerizable, and ready for AWS cloud deployment. You will collaborate closely with DevOps and database engineers as part of a cross\-functional Agile team delivering a phased, production\-safe migration. **Responsibilities:** * Migrate a .NET Framework 4\.8 application to .NET 10\. * Migrate a large database\-first Entity Framework 6 model to EF Core 8 across multiple bounded contexts, one domain at a time. * Identify and replace Windows\-only libraries and assembly references that prevent building and running on Linux. * Establish unit test coverage measurement and enforce quality gates as part of the migration pipeline. * Collaborate with the DevOps engineer on Dockerfile authoring, environment configuration, and secrets injection. * Participate in Agile/SCRUM processes, conduct code reviews, and document migration decisions. **Must\-Have Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of C\# and .NET backend development with strong knowledge of ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core. * Proven, hands\-on experience migrating .NET Framework applications to .NET Core / .NET 8, 10 in production. * Solid experience with Entity Framework Core.Solid knowledge of DDD, CQRS, and repository patterns in layered .NET architectures. * Familiarity with Docker multi\-stage builds and Linux container fundamentals for .NET applications. * Proficient with xUnit and Moq for unit testing; comfortable with container\-wired test setups. * Experience with AWS ECS / Fargate and ECR for deploying containerized .NET applications. * Familiarity with MassTransit and RabbitMQ or Amazon MQ for event\-driven messaging. * Experience with Hangfire or similar background job processing frameworks. * Proficient in Git and familiar with Agile/SCRUM team processes. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** * Experience building CI/CD pipelines for .NET projects. * Familiarity with micro\-frontend architecture and Angular\-based single\-page applications. * Experience with automated code coverage tooling and enforcing coverage thresholds in CI. * Experience with performance optimization and scalable enterprise backend systems. **We offer\*:** * Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible * A competitive salary and good compensation package * Personalized career growth * Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more) * Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing * Education reimbursement * Memorable anniversary presents * Corporate events and team buildings * Other location\-specific benefits * not applicable for freelancers

jobs.title: Data Engineer III
jobs.description: **POSITION OVERVIEW** NBME is looking for a Data Engineer to join a highly skilled and growing team of data engineers and BI developers. In this role, you will use your data engineering and problem\-solving skills to deliver meaningful insights to internal staff and external customers. The Data Engineer will help modernize, expand, and optimize NBME's data platform by building data lakes, complex data integration pipelines, and scalable data solutions that support analytics, AI/ML, and business decision\-making. This role will apply AI\-assisted engineering practices to improve development efficiency and share best practices for AI assisted engineering across the IT organization. While this role can be designated as remote, you are offered the flexibility to select if you prefer to work primarily remotely, hybrid, or onsite. We're open to considering candidates within 50 miles of our office location in Philadelphia, PA. ***Please note that onsite interviews and onboarding at our Philadelphia office may be required for this role. If applicable, advance notice will be provided to support planning.*** At NBME, we continue to innovate and improve how we fulfill the evolving needs of the healthcare community. This commitment starts and ends with the people at NBME. By recruiting and empowering talented individuals from various disciplines and backgrounds, which includes professionals with diverse life experiences, abilities, and perspectives, NBME can take a well\-informed, robust approach to advancing medical education and assessment for years to come. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Participates in requirements gathering, analyzes and architects project and/or system data architectures. environment. * Be a critical part of a scrum team in an agile environment, ensuring the team successfully meets its deliverables each sprint. * Trains and mentors team members * Work independently and effectively to manage one's time across multiple priorities and projects. * Assures the integrity and accuracy of the corporate data, with particular attention to data security. * Responsible to ensure high data quality for Data Services, Analytics and Master Data Management. * Perform Logical and Physical data modeling with an agile mindset * Build automated, scalable, test\-driven data pipelines. * Utilize software development practices such as version control via Git, CI/CD, and release management. * Build data products using various visualization, BI tools and data science tools. * Collaborate with Data Engineers, DevOps engineers and architects on improvement opportunities for DataOps tools and frameworks. * Be a trusted partner by providing agile capabilities and outstanding services through digital transformation **QUALIFICATIONS** **Skills and Abilities** * Expert in data modeling, database management and data profiling techniques, particularly in Data Warehouse, Master Data Management (MDM), and in the design and delivery of Business Intelligence solutions. * Deep understanding of industry standards and best practices * Strong analytic skills related to working with structured and unstructured datasets. * Critical thinker and creative problem\-solving skills along with the ability to communicate well with stakeholders throughout the organization. * Highly proficient in PL/SQL * Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including Oracle, MS SQL Server and HBase. * Experience with data integration tools: Informatica, Boomi, Fivetran, MS Integration Services, Sqoop, etc. * Experience with one of the cloud vendors and services: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Snowflake * Experience consuming and building APIs * Experience with object\-oriented/object function programming languages: Python, Java, C\+\+, Scala, etc. * Experience with visual analytics tools: QlikView, Tableau, Power BI, Micro strategy etc. * Experience utilizing Agile methodology for development. * Experience with Singer and DBT is a plus **Experience** * Minimum of 3 years of Data Engineering and Data Warehousing experience. * Minimum of 2 years of experience with python * Minimum of 2 years of experience with data integration tools like Informatica, Boomi, AWS \- Glue etc. * Minimum 1 year of experience with AWS services like S3 and Redshift **Education** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field and 6 years of relevant work experience. jobs.title: MEP Superintendent
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION **Job Title:** Senior MEP Superintendent **Alternate Titles:** MEP Project Engineer; Senior MEP Field Engineer **Reports To:** Site Superintendent / Senior Project Manager **Classification:** Full\-Time Position Summary Norfolk Design \& Construction, LLC is seeking a Senior MEP Superintendent to run daily field coordination of MEP/FP subcontractors while leading pre\-shutdown documentation, equipment disposition, and long\-duration shutdown planning for existing mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems ahead of building renovation. This is a hands\-on field leadership role: managing MEP subcontractors through daily tasks, problem\-solving, schedules, and sequencing; working closely with the owner’s MEP/FP facilities and commissioning staff; and driving the trade coordination that keeps the schedule on track. The role also owns the full existing\-systems lifecycle, from existing\-conditions survey through shutdown, controls transition, and eventual restart/commissioning. The ideal candidate is first and foremost a strong field superintendent with subcontractor management experience, who also brings systems/commissioning fluency to the shutdown and controls\-transition scope. Key ResponsibilitiesDaily Field Coordination \& Subcontractor Management * Manage MEP subcontractors' daily tasks, problem\-solving, schedules, and sequencing on site. * Take an active role in MEP coordination meetings and processes, including with Owner MEP/FP facilities and commissioning staff. * Conduct daily site walks and check in with the MEP foreman. * Assist with daily MEP/FP trade activities and input to the Procore Daily Log. * Assist with planning future work and look\-ahead schedules; work with the Columbia/Norfolk field team. * Support Hoylu work planning and look\-aheads. * Participate in the Daily Huddle with foreman. Pre\-Shutdown Documentation \& Equipment Disposition * Document existing conditions in all basement and penthouse mechanical rooms prior to building shutdown. * Build and maintain a room\-by\-room spreadsheet listing all existing equipment. * Label all equipment in every room with a unique equipment ID. * Indicate equipment disposition for each item: demo, existing to remain, or refurbish. * Document existing equipment operating status prior to shutdown (on/operating, off, leaking, corrosion, etc.). * Capture photos, videos, and Procore Observations for every documented item and condition. Shutdown Planning \& Execution * Assist in the shutdown of existing building equipment and systems. * Assess potential impacts of long\-duration shutdowns (steam, domestic water, water heaters, and similar systems sitting idle for a year or more). * Recommend immediate steps to protect systems during extended idle periods (draining, compressed air blow\-down, winterization, etc.). * Develop a formal Shutdown Plan, parallel in structure and rigor to a Start\-Up Plan. * Determine existing conditions status and assess the impact of the shutdown on equipment and systems' ability to restart the following year. Controls (ATC/DDC) \& Scope Coordination * Verify current status of existing building automation/temperature controls (ATC) systems. * Track demolition, removal/reinstallation, and integration of existing controls with new DDC systems. * Evaluate contract/construction documents against Schneider's scope of work to identify gaps requiring resolution. * Maintain the Annese fire alarm log. * Assist in developing a temporary heat plan for winter conditions. Submittals, QA/QC, Commissioning \& Closeout * Review MEP/FP submittals and RFIs; provide input and drive resolutions. * Perform MEP QA/QC and inspections. * Support system start\-up and commissioning. * Manage the MEP/FP punchlist through closeout. Qualifications * 10–15\+ years of MEP field/superintendent experience, including renovation/gut\-rehab projects with occupied or phased building shutdowns. * Proven track record managing MEP subcontractors directly — daily task direction, problem\-solving, schedule and sequencing ownership. * Strong daily field presence: comfortable running site walks, foreman check\-ins, and daily huddles, and coordinating with institutional facilities/commissioning staff (e.g., Owner MEP/FP facilities). * Experience with Procore and Hoylu (or comparable field management/scheduling platforms). * Experience reviewing MEP/FP submittals and RFIs, and driving resolutions to closure. * Direct experience decommissioning or mothballing existing building systems (steam, domestic water, hydronic, compressed air) for extended idle periods. * Working knowledge of BAS/DDC controls transitions, including demolition and integration of legacy pneumatic or analog controls with new DDC systems. * Ability to read and reconcile construction documents against a controls subcontractor's scope of work to identify and resolve gaps. * Strong documentation discipline: comfortable owning large equipment inventories, ID tagging systems, and photo/video/Procore Observation logging at scale. * Commissioning agent experience or certification (CxA, CCP, or equivalent) a plus, but not required — field leadership and subcontractor management are the priority. **Applicants should email their resume to office@us\-norfolk.com with the subject “Senior MEP Superintendent”** Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

inspection, or process experiments, and measure whether corrective actions are working. * Identify gaps in manufacturing and quality data, including missing data, inconsistent definitions, visibility into product and manufacturing quality. * Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science teams when new data pipelines or infrastructure are needed while owning the Hardware Quality use cases and analysis. * Communicate findings clearly and turn complex datasets into conclusions and recommendations that engineering teams and leadership can act on. **We would love to have you on our jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Web3
jobs.description: Senior Backend Engineer – Web3 \& Real\-Time Systems **Company:** Daily.fun **Location:** San Francisco, CA — On\-site preferred; exceptional remote candidates may be considered **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Experience:** Senior\-level **Compensation:** Competitive Base Salary \+ Meaningful Equity **Industry:** Consumer Technology / Web3 / Blockchain / FinTech / Gaming About Daily.fun Daily.fun is an early\-stage consumer technology company building the next generation of engaging, gamified market experiences. We are **a consumer tech company that happens to use blockchain**. Our goal is to bring prediction\-market and trading\-style experiences to a mass consumer audience through products that are significantly more engaging, entertaining, and accessible. The team is currently made up of **3 people — 2 Co\-Founders and 1 Founding Engineer**, with backgrounds including **Aave, Polymarket, and Google**. The company recently raised a **$2M seed round at a $40M valuation** and is preparing for its upcoming Demo Day, with plans to raise another round shortly afterward. We are building a highly ambitious product at the intersection of **Web3, prediction markets, trading mechanics, gaming, and consumer entertainment**. Our product is launching soon in Beta. About the Role We are looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer** to build and own the backend systems that power Daily.fun. You will work directly with the **CEO, Co\-Founders, and core technical team** to turn ambitious product ideas into reliable production systems — often within hours rather than weeks. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys building from the ground up, working with modern backend infrastructure, solving difficult systems problems, and shipping rapidly. You will be responsible for everything from **high\-throughput backend services and real\-time data pipelines to APIs, databases, indexing systems, infrastructure, and blockchain integrations**. There is no corporate bureaucracy or unnecessary middle management. You will own your systems end\-to\-end and have a direct impact on the product. What You'll DoBackend \& Distributed Systems * Design, build, and maintain high\-throughput backend services. * Build systems that remain fast, reliable, and scalable as user activity and transaction volume increase. * Develop clean, maintainable, and scalable backend architecture. * Work with APIs, databases, queues, caching systems, and distributed systems. * Identify and solve performance, reliability, and scalability bottlenecks. Data \& Infrastructure * Build and own backend APIs and production services. * Design data pipelines and real\-time workflows. * Build indexing systems for blockchain and application data. * Work with databases, caching layers, queues, and infrastructure. * Develop production tooling, monitoring, and systems that improve reliability. Blockchain \& Web3 * Integrate blockchain networks and on\-chain data into consumer\-facing products. * Work with smart contracts, wallets, transactions, and blockchain data. * Build and maintain blockchain indexing infrastructure. * Abstract blockchain complexity so that users can interact with the product without unnecessary Web3 friction. Product Development * Prototype new product ideas quickly. * Build experiments, ship them to production, analyze real\-world usage, and iterate. * Work closely with founders and technical leadership to translate product concepts into production\-ready systems. * Participate in architectural and technical decisions across the product. * Take ownership from initial design through deployment, monitoring, and optimization. High Ownership \& Execution * Own your systems end\-to\-end. * Make pragmatic technical decisions and move quickly. * Take responsibility for production performance and reliability. * Continuously improve systems based on real user behavior and product requirements. Required QualificationsBackend Engineering * Strong professional experience building and operating production backend systems. * Strong backend engineering fundamentals and systems\-design skills. * Strong experience with **TypeScript and Node.js**, or a comparable modern backend technology stack. * Experience designing and building APIs and production services. * Strong understanding of databases, queues, caching, and distributed systems. * Experience working with real\-time data or high\-concurrency systems is highly valuable. Engineering Mindset * Strong ownership mentality — you don't simply complete tickets; you solve problems. * Ability to move quickly from idea → prototype → production. * Comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment with ambiguity. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills. * High standards for code quality, architecture, reliability, and performance. * Comfortable taking responsibility for systems you build after they reach production. Web3 / Blockchain * Strong interest in or professional experience with Web3/blockchain  t interactions Additional bonus points for candidates who have been: * Founder * Founding Engineer * Early Engineer * Early employee at a fast\-growing Web3, FinTech, crypto, or consumer technology startup Ideal Candidate We're looking for someone who: * Loves backend engineering and enjoys talking deeply about technical problems. * Has strong backend depth and can explain the systems they've built. * Thinks in terms of scalability, reliability, performance, and architecture. * Has a strong bias toward execution and shipping. * Is comfortable working directly with founders. * Enjoys rapid experimentation and iteration. * Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions. * Genuinely enjoys building products and solving hard engineering problems. * Has experience with Web3 or is deeply motivated to work in the space. * Wants to have significant impact at a very early\-stage company. Why Join Daily.fun?Early \& High Impact You will be joining an extremely small team where every engineer has significant influence over the product and technical direction. Meaningful Equity You will join early and receive meaningful equity participation. Work Directly With Founders You will work closely with the CEO, Co\-Founders, and founding engineering team without layers of middle management. Build From the Ground Up You'll have the opportunity to architect and build core infrastructure rather than simply maintaining an existing system. Consumer \+ Web3 Work at the intersection of consumer technology, gaming, prediction markets, trading mechanics, and blockchain. Fast\-Paced Environment We move quickly, experiment frequently, and ship production software at a high velocity. Competitive Compensation * Competitive base salary * Meaningful equity * Health, Dental \& Vision benefits Work Environment **Primary location:** San Francisco, California. The team currently works intensely from San Francisco and strongly prefers an **on\-site candidate**. Exceptional remote candidates may be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. Important Candidate Consideration Because Daily.fun operates in the Web3/crypto ecosystem and is actively fundraising, **professional reputation and integrity are extremely important**. Candidates should have a strong professional track record and be able to demonstrate responsible work on previous projects and companies. Experience with legitimate, reputable Web3, FinTech, consumer technology, or related companies is highly valued. Compensation \& Package **Base Salary \+ Equity** Final compensation will be determined based on experience, technical depth, previous company/startup experience, Web3 expertise, and overall fit. How to Apply Please submit your resume along with relevant details about: * Backend systems you have built or scaled * Your experience with TypeScript/Node.js or comparable backend technologies * Any Web3/blockchain experience * High\-concurrency or real\-time systems you've worked on * Prediction markets, trading, gaming, FinTech, or DEX experience, if applicable * Any founder, founding engineer, or early\-stage startup experience **Please highlight your most technically challenging backend project and explain your role, architecture, scale, and impact.** Application Question(s): * Have you worked with databases, queues, caching, APIs, and distributed systems? * Do you have professional experience with Web3/blockchain technology? * Have you worked as a Founder, Founding Engineer, or early\-stage engineer at a startup? * Have you worked on prediction markets, trading systems, DEXs, perpetuals, gaming infrastructure, or FinTech products? * Describe your experience with Web3/blockchain infrastructure, including any chains, indexing systems, smart contracts, or wallets you've worked with. * What is the highest traffic, transaction volume, or concurrency level you have handled in production? jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Boston **About The Position** ---------------------- Qodo is building the AI code review and governance platform for the world’s most ambitious engineering organizations. Our customers are shipping AI\-generated code at a pace that breaks every assumption built into traditional code review, static analysis, and SDLC tooling. They turn to Qodo to keep quality, security, and governance from becoming the bottleneck. Forward Deployed Engineering sits at the frontier of that work. We embed with Qodo’s most strategic enterprise customers, running on\-prem, air\-gapped, and heavily regulated environments, and own the technical arc from discovery through production. Your day might include designing a solution architecture for a high\-impact agentic use case, debugging a production routing issue deep in our codebase, deploying a new MCP server with a customer team, or aligning with a CTO on a rollout plan; all in service of outstanding outcomes and rapid time to value for the organizations we work with. This is a founding function. The first FDEs will define how Qodo conducts field engineering: the standards, playbooks, and technical bar. The work is hands\-on, commercially scoped, and high\-leverage: you’ll partner closely with Product, Research, Platform, Security, and GTM, and what you learn in production directly shapes what the core team ships next. If you thrive under ambiguity, make fast and sound decisions when the stakes are high, and get energy from closing the gap between what customers hit in production and what we build next, this role is for you. **In This Role You Will** * Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production, including core engineering work that unblocks strategic accounts. * Lead deep technical diagnosis and remediation in our codebase and production environments, model routing and gateway behavior, large\-PR scaling, multi\-pass behavior, performance and reliability issues. * Build customer\-specific extensions (MCP servers, agent skills, platform integrations) that deliver immediate value and become durable product capability; upstream them into the main roadmap where appropriate. * Embed closely with customer engineering teams: serve as their senior technical counterpart for hands\-on debugging, architecture reviews, and joint implementation. * Scope work, sequence delivery, and remove blockers early; make deliberate trade\-offs between scope, speed, and quality to protect delivery timelines. * Partner with Product, Research, and Platform to convert account learnings and eval\-driven feedback into roadmap items, specs, and prioritized engineering work. * Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, runbooks, and reproducible benchmarks that Support and account teams can operate independently and help scale the field engineering function across the organization. * Keep teams moving through clarity and follow\-through; model calm judgment when the stakes are high. * Be a champion for our mission in the field: every deployment is an opportunity to demonstrate it. **Requirements** ---------------- **You Might Thrive in This Role If You** * Bring 5\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role as a Forward Deployed Engineer, a Software Engineer with consulting exposure, or a founder with hands\-on deployment experience. * Experience building or consuming MCP servers or agent frameworks. * Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast\-moving or ambiguous environments you know how to sequence work and protect delivery without slowing everything down. * Write and review production\-quality code in Python, TypeScript or comparable stacks; you contribute directly in the code when it matters. * Have production experience with LLMs: advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale and you actively stay current with the latest capabilities and implementation patterns. * Have debugged hard problems in live distributed systems under time pressure and can write a postmortem that actually prevents recurrence. * Have shipped integrations that started as customer\-specific work and became broadly reusable product capability. * Communicate clearly with engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike; you conduct discovery well, convey technical concepts to diverse audiences, and spot risks early enough to act on them. **Nice to Have** * Background in enterprise platform engineering, multi\-tenancy design, or large\-scale monorepo tooling. * Prior work with model routing, inference infrastructure, or LLM gateway systems.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: United States **About The Position** ---------------------- At Qodo, we’re building an AI Code Review platform that helps developers move fast, ship with confidence, and elevate code quality across the SDLC through deep, scalable codebase understanding. As a Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud\-Prem) at Qodo, you will take total ownership of our enterprise deployments, running and integrating our Kubernetes\-based platform directly inside customer\-managed cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure). This is a highly autonomous, ground\-level role where you’ll navigate complex, unfamiliar systems, solve zero\-day installation challenges, and make high\-stakes client deployments succeed from day one. In this role you will * Own Enterprise Deployments: Take end\-to\-end ownership of installing, configuring, and upgrading Qodo’s Kubernetes\-based stack within customer\-managed cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) * Debug \& Reverse\-Engineer: Real\-time troubleshooting on environments you are seeing for the first time. You’ll pull diagnostics, identify root causes, and write custom Python/Bash scripts to overcome network, access, or platform constraints * Bridge Engineering \& Customers: Serve as a high\-touch technical counterpart to enterprise engineering teams during onboardings, eliminating time\-zone delays for US\-based clients (working alongside Solutions Engineering as needed) * Build for Scale \& Self\-Document: Codify best practices into IaC modules (Terraform, Helm) and create a structured internal knowledge base to turn “one\-off” fixes into repeatable, automated onboarding procedures * Drive Reliability: Ensure optimal performance and health of core infrastructure components (PostgreSQL, Redis, container networking, and storage) within isolated client stacks **Requirements** ---------------- * 5\+ Years in DevOps / Infrastructure: Proven track record in product\-driven B2B SaaS, DevOps tooling, or developer platform companies * Autonomous \& Autodidactic: Extreme ownership mentality—comfortable navigating ambiguity, making technical decisions independently, and driving projects forward without waiting for top\-down direction * Client\-Facing DNA: Hands\-on experience in customer\-facing deployment, technical onboarding, or Field DevOps contexts. You communicate clearly and build trust with client engineers under pressure * Location: You must be located in Central Time Zone USA Technical Core * Deep Kubernetes \& Containers: Expert\-level, hands\-on experience running, troubleshooting, and tuning complex production Kubernetes clusters and Docker containers * Cloud \& IaC Mastery: Proficiency with Terraform and Helm across major public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure), particularly within customer VPC/tenant boundaries * Networking \& Infrastructure Services: Solid understanding of Linux networking, IAM/security policies, storage drivers, and database infrastructure management (PostgreSQL, Redis) * Diagnostic Scripting: Strong capability in Python or Bash to write quick diagnostic tools, automation scripts, and deployment fixes Nice to Have * Software development background (building tools, services, or SDKs) * Experience with AI/ML developer tools or enterprise developer platforms * Prior experience being the first remote hire in a region or building early\-stage operational playbooks For this position at Qodo, we offer: * The expected salary range for this role is $160,000 – $180,000 per year. Actual compensation will depend on various factors, including experience, skills, and location * All Qodo team members are also eligible for stock options, reflecting our belief in shared ownership and long\-term growth * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents, with company contributions toward your premiums * 401(k) plan * Commuter Allowance: We support flexible work, and for those who travel to the office two or more times a week, Qodo provides a commuter allowance to cover part of your travel costs * Paid Time\-Off: 23 vacation days

jobs.title: Civil Construction Manager
jobs.description: **Construction Manager – Lead Heavy Civil \& Concrete Paving Projects** **Company:** Reede Construction, Inc.**Location:** Aberdeen, SD — Home base/relocation required**Compensation:** $80,000–$120,000\+ per year, depending on experience**Employment Type:** Full\-Time**Travel:** Extensive regional travel, up to 90% during active construction periods**Project Scope:** Highway, DOT, FAA, municipal, federal, concrete, paving, and heavy civil infrastructure projects **The Opportunity** Reede Construction, Inc. is seeking an experienced Construction Manager to lead complex heavy civil concrete and paving projects throughout the Upper Midwest. This is a hands\-on leadership position for a construction professional who can successfully operate in both the field and the management side of the business. You will oversee project execution, support field teams, manage cost and schedule performance, coordinate project documentation, and help strengthen the systems and processes behind Reede Construction's continued growth. The ideal candidate brings strong heavy civil or transportation construction experience and is comfortable working directly with crews, project stakeholders, DOT representatives, subcontractors, and company leadership. This position is based in Aberdeen, South Dakota, with regular travel to active project sites. Reede Construction primarily operates throughout North Dakota and South Dakota, with additional work across Nebraska, Minnesota, Wyoming, and surrounding Upper Midwest markets. **How You Will Make an Impact*** Lead daily field and project operations for highway, transportation, concrete, paving, and heavy civil construction projects. * Maintain a strong field presence while providing leadership to foremen, crews, subcontractors, and project personnel. * Manage project schedules, labor, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and site logistics to support safe and profitable execution. * Monitor project costs, production goals, KPIs, and overall job performance. * Implement and maintain DOT, FAA, AASHTO, and project\-specific quality requirements. * Coordinate with owners, engineers, inspectors, DOT representatives, subcontractors, and internal leadership. * Identify and resolve technical, operational, scheduling, and logistical issues before they impact project delivery. * Support contract administration, documentation, shop drawings, change management, and project closeout activities. * Participate in construction planning, scheduling, cost reviews, and project forecasting. * Help develop and mentor field leaders while reinforcing accountability, safety, quality, and operational consistency. * Support estimating, takeoffs, preconstruction planning, and bid\-to\-build handoffs during the winter and off\-season. * Help implement and improve technology, systems, and processes that increase efficiency and strengthen project management across the organization. **Required Qualifications \& Experience*** 5\+ years of relevant experience in heavy civil, highway, DOT, transportation, concrete paving, or comparable infrastructure construction. * Demonstrated experience leading active construction projects, crews, or major project scopes. * Strong understanding of field operations, construction sequencing, scheduling, cost control, safety, and quality management. * Ability to manage multiple project priorities while maintaining attention to detail and accountability. * Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills. * Comfortable working in both field and office environments. * Willingness to travel extensively throughout Reede Construction's regional project footprint. * Willingness to relocate to or maintain a permanent home base in the Aberdeen, SD area. **Preferred Qualifications \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field. * Civil Engineering background or Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. * Experience working directly with state DOTs, FAA projects, municipalities, or other government agencies. * Experience with concrete paving, highway construction, transportation infrastructure, or major civil site work. * Experience with project estimating, takeoffs, bidding, and preconstruction. * Familiarity with HCSS HeavyBid. * Familiarity with Bluebeam. * Experience with Oracle\-based construction planning or scheduling systems, including Oracle Primavera Cloud (OPC) or comparable platforms. * Experience progressing through superintendent, project manager, construction manager, or similar field\-leadership roles. **Travel \& Work Environment*** This is not a remote management position. * Construction Managers are expected to maintain a meaningful presence on active project sites. * Projects are primarily located throughout the Upper Midwest, with many assignments within approximately a four\-hour radius of Aberdeen. * Depending on project location and schedule, Construction Managers should generally expect opportunities to return home at least every other weekend, although critical project periods may require extended time on site. * A company vehicle is provided. * Travel\-related per diem and support are provided in accordance with company policy. * Reede Construction works with employees individually when practical to help manage longer\-distance travel demands. **Compensation \& Benefits*** Competitive annual salary of $80,000–$120,000\+, depending on experience and role level. * Company vehicle. * Travel per diem. * 401(k) retirement savings program with employer matching. * Medical, dental, life, and disability insurance options. * Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave. * Paid training and safety certifications. * Professional development and mentorship opportunities. * Referral bonus program. * Company\-sponsored events. * Company\-provided uniforms. **Why Reede Construction** Reede Construction, Inc. is a family\-owned heavy civil contractor with more than 30 years of experience delivering transportation and infrastructure projects. The company is entering its next stage of growth and is actively investing in stronger leadership, modern construction technology, improved operating systems, and increased management depth. For the right Construction Manager, this is an opportunity to do more than manage individual projects. You will have the ability to help improve how projects are planned, managed, and delivered while building a long\-term career within an established and growing organization. *About Reede Construction, Inc.**Reede Construction, Inc. specializes in heavy civil, highway, concrete paving, airport, municipal, government, and federal infrastructure construction. Our multi\-generational team is committed to superior craftsmanship, safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.* *Reede Construction, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on job\-related qualifications and business needs without regard to any status protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer, Revenue Operations** -------------------------------------------- **About Stream** ---------------- Stream powers real\-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for billions of end\-users across thousands of apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low\-latency services and a great developer experience. **The role** ------------ The data platform in this role is what our go\-to\-market and product decisions run on. You'll own the pipelines, integrations, and central repository that bring Stream's data together, plus the models that turn it into something the business can trust. We're mid\-migration to GCP, so there's real architecture to shape. Two things make this different from most data jobs. A Revenue Operations team owns the stakeholder relationships and the business questions, so your time goes into building durable systems instead of chasing requirements. And analytics translation is increasingly handled by AI, which is exactly why the engineering underneath it has to be right. Data modeling is the core of this role. It's a small team and a fast, unfinished environment. High drive, sometimes hectic. If you like owning a platform end to end, that's the appeal. **This is a full\-time job opening based in Boulder (3 days hybrid).** **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and evolve the ingestion platform.** Python/dltHub pipelines loading into BigQuery, integrating Salesforce, Stripe, Postgres, PostHog, cloud billing, and other GTM systems. Design incremental loading, write dispositions, and scheduling, and make onboarding a new source predictable and low\-risk. * **Build the transformation layer.** SQLMesh models across our layered architecture, clean and well\-tested dimensional models, and clear conventions for grain, naming, and audit. Keep the core business models accurate: revenue waterfall, GTM funnel, marketing attribution, and product usage. * **Improve reliability.** Expand data quality and observability, build freshness checks, reconciliation tests, and execution monitoring. Take point when data is stale, wrong, or late, and trace issues across pipelines, transformations, and upstream systems. * **Own the platform infrastructure.** BigQuery and supporting GCP, plus Terraform, IAM, service accounts, scheduled jobs, and deployment workflows, tuned for security, reliability, and cost. * **Enable the business.** Deliver trusted datasets to Looker Studio, Google Sheets, and our internal CRM, and run reverse ETL back into operational systems like Salesforce. * **Raise the technical bar.** Help shape engineering standards and architecture, review pipeline and model changes, and share context with the analysts and engineers who contribute to the platform. **About you** ------------- You like owning a platform end to end and staying hands\-on while you do it. You're comfortable in a small team, and you're energized by building rather than by growing an org around you. You influence through the work: architecture, code review, and clear conventions, not a title. **You have:** * 5\+ years building and operating production data platforms * Expert SQL and strong Python * Experience designing incremental, idempotent, well\-tested pipelines * Solid experience with BigQuery or another modern cloud data warehouse * Experience with modern ELT tooling such as SQLMesh, dbt, dltHub, Fivetran, or Airbyte * Experience with orchestration and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Airflow, or equivalent) * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform or a close equivalent * Strong data modeling skills: dimensional modeling, warehouse design, testing, and observability **Bonus points:** * Revenue Operations or GTM data experience * Salesforce and Stripe data modeling * Product analytics platforms such as PostHog * Marketing attribution and funnel analytics * MRR, expansion, contraction, churn, and revenue reconciliation logic * Working closely with business stakeholders while keeping engineering discipline * GCP depth, including IAM, service accounts, and BigQuery cost optimization ### **Why this one is worth a look** * You own the data platform the whole company runs on, not one pipeline or one domain. * Your work powers forecasting, commissions, pricing, churn analysis, product insight, and board reporting. The quality of your engineering shows up directly in how the company runs. * The stack is modern and AI\-forward: Python, dlt, SQLMesh, BigQuery, Terraform, GitHub Actions, with Claude, Cursor, and Linear across the team. * You inherit a foundation that already works, built from scratch, so you evolve and harden it rather than start from zero. ### **You'll thrive here if** * You want a broad, ambiguous platform to own and the autonomy to make calls on it * You ship fast and learn fast, even when things are unfinished * You're comfortable working with teammates across time zones **You probably won't if** you want tightly scoped tickets, a fully defined process before acting, or a slow and highly predictable environment. **Why join Stream?** -------------------- We're a Series B company with global presence and a team of around 145 people from more than 35 countries. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex\-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston\-Werner (co\-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co\-founder of Algolia).
